title: DeltaVisionX: A Low-Cost Vision-Guided Automation System Using YOLOv11 and PLC-Based Actuation
abstract: arXiv:2611.17959v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents DeltaVisionX, a low-cost industrial automation system that integrates real-time computer vision with PLC-based actuation for object classification and sorting. The system uses the YOLOv11 (You Only Look Once) deep learning model to detect objects on an operating conveyor belt and communicates detection results to a Delta DVP-SE PLC, which actuates pneumatic pistons for sorting. A custom dataset was created, labeled, and augmented to train the YOLOv11 model, achieving a mean average precision of 0.97 with real-time inference of 100 ms per frame. Encoder-based tracking ensures reliable synchronization between detection and actuation, supporting a throughput of 80 objects per minute. Results show that affordable, locally developed automation can reduce labor dependency and improve manufacturing efficiency. translated_title: DeltaVisionX：一种基于YOLOv11与PLC驱动的低成本视觉引导自动化系统
translated_abstract: 本文提出了DeltaVisionX，这是一种低成本的工业自动化系统，它将实时计算机视觉与基于PLC的驱动控制相结合，用于物体的分类与分拣。该系统使用YOLOv11（You Only Look Once）深度学习模型检测运行中传送带上的物体，并将检测结果传递给Delta DVP-SE PLC，由PLC驱动气动活塞完成分拣。研究团队创建、标注并增强了一个自定义数据集用于训练YOLOv11模型，实现了0.97的平均精度均值（mAP），实时推理速度为每帧100毫秒。基于编码器的跟踪机制确保了检测与驱动执行之间的可靠同步，支持每分钟80个物体的处理吞吐量。结果表明，经济实惠的本地化开发自动化系统能够减少对人工的依赖并提高制造效率。所提系统的新颖之处在于其编码器同步的视觉-PLC集成架构，而非检测算法本身。
tldr: DeltaVisionX通过编码器同步的YOLOv11视觉检测与PLC气动驱动集成，实现了低成本、高精度（mAP 0.97）和高吞吐量（每分钟80件）的自动化物体分拣系统。
en_tdlr: DeltaVisionX integrates YOLOv11-based real-time vision detection with encoder-synchronized PLC actuation to achieve a low-cost automated sorting system with high accuracy (0.97 mAP) and throughput (80 objects per minute).
